answer: Guard the economy with a narrow inlet every newcomer must pass: a falcon patrol of randomly assigned veterans watches the gate and verifies one real job before entry, so no identity slips in unseen. Each agent also carries ferrous ballast, a small stake locked while it proves itself, forfeited if it is shown to be a duplicate. Entry records go into a paired migration ledger, so two identities sharing one history are exposed at once. A Sybil farm must pass the falcon watch, fund fresh ballast, and forge a clean ledger for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
